text.p: Results in the latest round of Sunday League (40 overs) cricket matches:
At Old Trafford: Lancashire beat Northamptonshire by 75 runs. Lancashire 241-6 in 40 overs (J.Gallian 101 not out). Northamptonshire 166 all out in 39.4 overs (R.Bailey 67; P.Martin 5-21).
At Leicester: Surrey beat Leicestershire by 5 wickets. Leicestershire 234-7 in 40 overs. Surrey 238-5 in 36.4 overs (A.Brown 157 not out).
At Horsham: Sussex beat Kent by 4 wickets. Kent 220-9 in 40 overs (M.Walker 60, A.Khan 5-40). Sussex 224-6 in 39.3 overs (W.Athey 109 not out).
At Cardiff: Glamorgan beat Hampshire by 6 wickets. Hampshire 180-8 in 40 overs. Glamorgan 181-4 in 38 overs (A.Dale 53).
At Taunton: Yorkshire beat Somerset by 7 wickets. Somerset 260-7 in 40 overs (R.Harden 85, P.Bowler 61). Yorkshire 261-3 in 36.1 overs (D.Lehmann 76, M.Vaughan 66).
At Chester-le-Street: Durham beat Worcestershire by 7 wickets. Worcestershire 177-6 in 40 overs (D.Leatherdale 53). Durham 180-3 in 34.4 overs (M.Speight 61).
At Edgbaston: Warwickshire beat Middlesex by 108 runs. Warwickshire 222-5 in 40 overs (D.Ostler 68 not out, N.Smith 53). Middlesex 114 all out in 32.5 overs (G.Small 5-26).
At Gloucester: Essex beat Gloucestershire by 5 wickets. Gloucestershire 139 all out in 39.2 overs. Essex 142-5 in 26.5 overs (S.Law 58).
At Trent Bridge: Nottinghamshire beat Derbyshire by 32 runs. Nottinghamshire 280-6 in 40 overs (P.Johnson 117, G.Archer 104 not out). Derbyshire 248-7 in 40 overs (C.Adams 121).
